findings.issue: Composed meaning is inverted: 'rarely fails to come about' reads as 'almost always happens', while めったに行われません means it is seldom carried out. Also 行われる is 'be carried out/held', not 'come about'. The pt literal keeps the negation transparently; the en one does not.
findings.current: As for now, it rarely fails to come about.
findings.suggested: As for now, [it] is rarely carried out (rarely, is-not-carried-out).

findings.issue: Wrong word-class claim: 主な is not a 連体詞; it is the attributive (連体形) of the na-adjective 主(だ) (形容動詞, cf. Daijisen/Meikyo). Only その is a 連体詞. This teaches a false POS classification.
findings.current: Note the two 連体詞 (pre-nominal words) その and 主な, which modify 産業 directly, without needing a particle.
findings.suggested: その is a 連体詞; 主な is the attributive form of the na-adjective 主(な). Both modify 産業 directly, without a particle.

findings.issue: Same wrong grammar claim as expl_en: 主な é classificado como 連体詞, mas é a forma adnominal do adjetivo-na 主(だ); só その é 連体詞.
findings.current: Note os dois 連体詞 (palavras pré-nominais) その e 主な, que modificam 産業 diretamente, sem precisar de partícula.
findings.suggested: その é um 連体詞; 主な é a forma adnominal do adjetivo-na 主(な). Ambos modificam 産業 diretamente, sem partícula.

findings.issue: Token 主な is labeled 連体詞 (pre-nominal determiner); it is a na-adjective in attributive form, not a 連体詞.
findings.current: determinante pré-nominal (連体詞), modifica 産業
findings.suggested: adjetivo-na em forma adnominal, modifica 産業

findings.issue: 話す is the verb 'to speak' (role says 'verbo principal', note says dictionary form), but the gloss is the noun 'speech' (that would be 話/はなし). Wrong POS/sense for this token.
Gloss 'fala' mirrors the erroneous noun gloss; verb tokens in this corpus are glossed in the infinitive (construir, trabalhar, devolver...). Should be 'falar'.
Garbled/copy-paste gloss: it references よくない ('não é bom'), which does not occur in this sentence. Here いい is simply the adjective 'good' in dictionary form (en gloss and note are correct).
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)

findings.issue: Final か is rendered as the agreement tag 'right?' (that would be ね); here か closes an exclamatory self-directed wish (どんなにいいか), as the expl itself states. The tag misteaches the particle's function.
findings.current: If this were automated, how nice would that be, right?
findings.suggested: If this were automated, how nice would that be(, I wonder)!

findings.issue: 'né?' equivale a ね (pedido de concordância), não ao か exclamativo/desiderativo desta frase; contradiz a própria expl, que descreve か como fecho exclamativo de desejo.
findings.current: Se isto for automatizado, o quão bom (seria), né?
findings.suggested: Se isto for automatizado, o quão bom (seria)!
